pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu janapade sāvatthiṃ gacchanto aññatarena gāmadvārena atikkamati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.3: aññatarā itthi sāmikena saha bhaṇḍitvā gāmato nikkhamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.8: atha kho tassā itthiyā sāmiko gāmato nikkhamitvā manussepucchi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.11: atha kho so puriso anubandhitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gahetvā ākoṭetvā muñci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.12: atha kho so bhikkhu aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle padhūpento nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.13: atha kho sā itthi taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.15: api ca ahameva tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ gacchāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.18: atha kho so puriso taṃ bhikkhuṃ khamāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.19: atha kho so bhikkhu sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.20: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.21: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissatī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.22: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.25: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.27: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.28.1: “yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.6: manussitthi na yakkhī na petī na tiracchānagatā viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhullāduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.10: gacchāma bhagini, gacchāma ayya, gacchāma ayya, gacchāma bhagini, ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā gacchāmāti saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.12: kukkuṭasampāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.13: agāmake araññe addhayojane addhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.2: mātugāme vematiko saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.3: mātugāme amātugāmasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.4: bhikkhu saṃvidahati mātugāmo na saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.5: yakkhiyā vā petiyā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatamanussaviggahitthiyā vā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti dukkaṭassa.
